findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cancel_flight_booking, get_booking, get_booking_link, get_flight_booking, get_hotel_reviews, get_past_trips, get_travel_profiles, get_upcoming_trips, get_vehicle_booking_link · Private data: cancel_flight_booking · Public sink: cancel_flight_booking, create_rate_alert, get_booking, get_past_trips, get_travel_profiles, get_vehicle_booking_link · Destructive: delete_rate_alert.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cancel_flight_booking, get_booking, get_booking_link, get_flight_booking, get_hotel_reviews, get_past_trips, get_travel_profiles, get_upcoming_trips, get_vehicle_booking_link · Private data: cancel_flight_booking · Public sink: cancel_flight_booking, create_rate_alert, get_booking, get_past_trips, get_travel_profiles, get_vehicle_booking_link · Destructive: delete_rate_alert

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
